<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1106
Claimant:
Michele Williams
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
June 7, 2024
Claim received for a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The insured's vehicle was struck from behind while
stopped, and the claimant reports whiplash symptoms. Claimant is represented by counsel, so all further contact will
go through the attorney's office.
July 1, 2024
Police report obtained and reviewed. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact and records the
other driver's account, which matches the initial report.
July 12, 2024
Statements taken from two independent witnesses. Both describe the impact the same way as the insured and the
other driver, and neither has any connection to the parties.
July 26, 2024
Photographs of both vehicles reviewed. The damage is mostly in line with the described impact speed and direction,
and no prior body damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the appraiser's inspection.
October 1, 2024
Verified that the driver involved is named on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss, with no
indication the damage predtaes the policy period.
December 2, 2024
Medical records requested through counsel. The reported injury fits the kind and force of a crash of this type. Prior
records show a minor strain in the same area years ago that resolved fully.
January 18, 2025
Treatment reviewed. It followed a usual course, with care tapering as the claimant improved. Claimant later supplied
a few additional details about the accident, but the core account has stayed consistent across every statement given.
January 20, 2025
File reviewed with supervisor. Liability apperas clear on the other driver's side, and the claim will proceed to
evaluation of the injury component through counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
